description: What the model returns for one analysis request. Uses only JSON Schema features that Claude structured outputs accept; limits it cannot express are enforced by the validation layer (see the response-validation capability).

summary.description: One to three sentences on what the log shows. Say plainly when no problems were found. At most 1,000 characters.

findings.description: Distinct problems the log shows. Empty when there are none.

title.description: Short headline for the problem, at most 120 characters.

severity.description: critical: an outage, crash or data loss. error: failed operations without a full outage. warning: degradation or a risk of failure. info: noteworthy but harmless.

category.description: exception: unhandled or logged exceptions. timeout: operations exceeding a time limit. dependency: failing calls to databases, HTTP services or queues. resource: exhausted memory, connections, threads or disk. security: authentication, authorization or suspicious access. performance: slow operations that still succeed. configuration: missing or invalid settings. other: anything else.

line_refs.description: 1-based line numbers of the submitted log that support this finding.

evidence.description: An excerpt copied character for character from one of the cited lines.

explanation.description: Why this matters and the most likely cause, based only on what the log shows.

suggested_action.description: The next thing an engineer should check or do.
